omissions.source_span: Standard Model is not C-invariant while CPT is preserved
omissions.reason: The load-bearing constraint on the triality extension is the non-invariance of the Standard Model under C, which necessitates the specific commutation properties of t.

boundary_notes: The extraction focuses on the definition of t but omits the physical motivation/constraint that defines the demand for the extension.

omissions.source_span: these conjugations are load-bearing for the discrete generators
omissions.reason: The extraction omits the explicit assertion that these conjugations are load-bearing, which is the primary semantic justification for their inclusion in the census.

boundary_notes: The extraction treats the conjugation list as a set of objects but misses the functional role assigned to them in the source.

omissions.source_span: from C/P/T/t the source also constructs a complex/creation conjugation K
omissions.reason: The extraction misses the construction dependency on the set {C, P, T, t} as a whole.

boundary_notes: The extraction of K is incomplete regarding the input set.

omissions.source_span: on QFT operators it exchanges annihilation with creation, maps positive-energy states to nonphysical negative-energy states
omissions.reason: These are the load-bearing semantic effects of K that define its non-symmetry status.

boundary_notes: The extraction captures the commutation relations but omits the operational definition of K on the state space.
